consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if the Consul provider `namespace` option is set.

original.statement: The Consul provider's `namespace` configuration option, deprecated in v2, is removed in v3 and unsupported; Traefik will fail to start if it is set.

decision.reason: [ev-3ab5da393af7] says the removed Consul `namespace` option "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". So an environment that still sets it cannot bring up the upgraded Traefik at all. That fits upgrade-blocked (an unmet precondition on the static configuration), which calls for action, and critical severity suits the proxy not starting. The proposed statement says this in the evidence's own terms.
